const char* Layer_3_text = "12:23 PM";
const char* Workout_day_text = "Monday: Push";

 
void draw(void) {
    // Layer 3
    tft.setTextColor(0xE33F);
    tft.setTextSize(1);
    tft.setFreeFont();
    tft.drawString(Layer_3_text, 7, 7);

    // Day_Date
    tft.drawString(Day_Date_text, 70, 7);

    // Workout_day

    // Layer 12

    // Layer 13
    tft.fillRect(266, 34, 7, 190, 0x506C);

    // Layer 14
    tft.fillRect(265, 59, 9, 15, 0xE33F);

    // Layer 15
    tft.drawLine(266, 65, 272, 65, 0x506C);

    // Layer 16
    tft.drawLine(266, 68, 272, 68, 0x506C);

    // Layer 17
    tft.drawLine(266, 71, 272, 71, 0x506C);

    // top_margins
    tft.drawBitmap(0, 0, image_top_margins_bits, 280, 21, 0x6870);

    // Layer 18
    tft.drawLine(266, 62, 272, 62, 0x506C);

    // Layer 20
    tft.drawRect(8, 108, 48, 48, 0x506C);

    // Layer 21
    tft.drawRect(8, 181, 48, 48, 0x506C);

    // Layer 25
    tft.setTextSize(2);
    tft.drawString("Log Workout", 91, 52);

    // bluetooth_connected
    tft.drawBitmap(227, 4, image_bluetooth_connected_bits, 7, 11, 0xE33F);

    // Layer 26
    tft.setTextColor(0x6870);
    tft.drawString("Settings", 91, 125);

    // download
    tft.drawBitmap(263, 226, image_download_bits, 14, 8, 0x6870);

    // download

    // Layer 28

    // download
    tft.drawBitmap(266, 224, image_download_2_bits, 7, 4, 0x506C);

    // download

    // Layer 32
